rows.en: ＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿００１There's something I'd like￥to ask you...＝＠０６４＿００２Have you been doing well lately?＝＠０６４＿００３Your scores have been high, so I￥was wondering just how much￥training you've been putting in.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿００４Is it because your training is￥so rigorous that you're getting￥such results?
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿００５I thought so. Then I should￥follow your example and step up￥my own training.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿００６Of all these experts, you were￥the one chosen, with your strong￥all-around ability...＝＠０６４＿００７Maybe that's because you had￥that kind of aptitude.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿００８Ranking near the top among￥the candidates...＝＠０６４＿００９is on a different level than￥among ordinary people.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０１０It's no easy feat... You make￥it look effortless, and for that￥I respect you.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０１３No, I'm not saying it to￥flatter you.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０１５As a fellow candidate, I intend￥to learn from you.＝＠０６４＿０１６I think it will help me with my￥own training.
＊Kairi＊＠０６４＿０１７Sorry to bother you on your day￥off. I'll take my leave...
